Pine Stainless Steel Flask – 400ml Premium Insulated Water Bottle

The Pine Stainless Steel Flask is designed for individuals who value durability, style, and everyday convenience. With a capacity of 400ml, this flask is perfect for daily hydration needs at the office, during travel, workouts, or outdoor activities. Featuring a sleek matte black exterior for a modern, professional look, this premium flask blends functionality with elegant aesthetics.

Crafted from high-quality food-grade stainless steel, the Pine Stainless Steel Flask, Capacity: 400ml, ensures long-lasting performance and resistance to rust, stains, and odors. Its compact size makes it easy to carry in backpacks, handbags, laptop bags, or car cup holders, making it a reliable companion wherever you go.

Premium Design with Modern Appeal

The sleek matte black exterior for a modern, professional look adds a sophisticated touch that suits corporate environments, business gifting, and everyday personal use. In addition to black, this flask is available in colour: Black, Blue, Red, White, allowing you to choose a shade that matches your personality or brand identity.

Whether you prefer a bold red, a classic white, a calming blue, or a timeless black, the Pine flask delivers premium visual appeal combined with ergonomic comfort. Its smooth matte finish offers a firm grip while resisting fingerprints and scratches.

Superior Insulation & Performance

Designed to maintain temperature efficiently, the Pine stainless steel water helps keep beverages hot or cold for extended hours. Ideal for tea, coffee, water, juice, or energy drinks, it supports an active lifestyle without compromising on taste or freshness.

The leak-proof cap ensures spill-free usage, making it safe to carry in bags during commuting or travel. This 400ml stainless steel flask is lightweight yet sturdy, offering the perfect balance between portability and capacity.

Businesses looking for premium stainless steel for gifting will appreciate the versatile colour options and professional finish that appeal to a wide audience.
